scenes.description: A hand pressing a loaf of bread taken from a freezer, the bread remaining rigid and rock-hard with a few ice crystals on its surface. A plain open freezer in the background, no display or labels.
A mechanical mantel clock has twelve clear hour markers and two hands, with exposed side gears and small ticking marks beside the escapement.
A nervous-looking presenter stands rigidly behind a lectern, shoulders raised and fists held at their sides, facing a seated audience.
At a table with two arrangements of wooden blocks, one person turns away with folded arms while another offers an alternative.
